title: WHO AMONG THE GODS IS LIKE YOU?

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text:
"Who among the gods is like you, LORD? Who is like you-majestic in holiness,
awesome in glory, working wonders? You stretch out your right hand, and the
earth swallows your enemies." - Ex 15:11-12 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
This question is the high point of the song. Who is like You?

Israel had lived four hundred years surrounded by gods. Egypt had them in
abundance, gods of the river, the sun, the harvest, the dead. Israel had watched
every one of them fail.

Notice what the song singles out as making God incomparable. Not that He is the
strongest, though He is. "Majestic in holiness." His difference is moral, not
merely physical.

That matters enormously. A god who was simply more powerful than other gods
would be terrifying but not trustworthy. Power alone is not good news. What makes
God worthy of worship is that His unlimited power is joined to perfect
holiness, and Scripture goes further: God is love (1 John 4:8).

This is the God who later steps into our world in Christ. When Isaiah's vision
of the Holy One is echoed in the New Testament, John says it was Christ's glory
he saw (John 12:41). The holiness that makes God incomparable came near enough
to touch.

The question "Who is like you?" has one honest answer. No one. And that One
loves you.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. What competes with God for the highest place in your life?
2. Is your awe of God rooted in His power, His holiness, or both?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, there is no one like You. You are holy beyond my understanding and loving
beyond my deserving. I worship You. Amen.
